title: The Room of the Bell House
author: Emrys Vane
blurb: Isandro Zhou, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
